channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gary Payton II | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gary Payton II from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II:

“He told me this year he wants to be a Lamborghini instead of a Ferrari because they’re not in the shop as much.”

Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II, Jan 18, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II
item.description:
CJ Holmes:Steve Kerr on Shams breaking the Gary Payton II starting news:

“We have a special correspondent in the organization that shares lineups with Shams, apparently.”

Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II, May 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.

item.title: Bob Myers on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Warriors GMBob Myers on asking NBA to look into Portland handling Gary Payton II injury:

“Good question, but I don't want to answer that. I can't go down that road of accusations.”

Bob Myers on Gary Payton II, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Steve Kerr on what Gary Payton II is able to do right now:

“Rehab. It's all rehab. He isn't on the court. There's a reason it'll be a month until we reassess things.”

Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II, Feb 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II:

“He's got a huge brace on his arm. He's going to be out for a long time, and he's crushed... In the spotlight, playing in the playoffs, playing a huge role, and playing well. That's all been taken away from him. We all feel terrible for Gary.”

Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II, May 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Gary Payton II
item.description:
“We obviously wish Gary Payton II a speedy and healthy recovery. It's very unfortunate what happened there.”

Taylor Jenkins on Gary Payton II, May 5, 2022. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Gary Payton II
item.description:
“A lot in this short time has transpired. I'm still trying to get over the fact that G.P. (Gary Payton II) hit that big shot, right? I'm extremely grateful for this opportunity. I'm happy to be a part of this group. I'm happy with the opportunity that was given to me from Mike, [Nuggets president] Tim [Connelly], [Nuggets general manager Calvin] Booth. To answer that question, I can't right now. I don't know what's future holds.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Gary Payton II, Apr 28, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on the Gary Payton II injury:

“Gary hit his shin on a railing or maybe a chair... Hopefully it's nothing too serious, but we won't know yet until he gets re-evaluated.”

Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II, Feb 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevin Durant, James Harden, Gary Payton II
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on if Gary Payton II will guard Kevin Durant and James Harden:

“He's one of our best defensive players. So Gary will for sure be out there on Kevin and James both.”

Steve Kerr on Kevin Durant, James Harden, Gary Payton II, Nov 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on all the Gary Payton II highlight lobs:

“I don't know how he does it. He's the same height as me.”

Stephen Curry on Gary Payton II, Nov 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II:

“Love his energy, love his defense, love his internsity. As you saw in Boston the other night, he's capable of turning a game's momentum... I'm really excited to have him back for another 10 days at least.”

Steve Kerr on Gary Payton II, Apr 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Gary Payton II
item.description:
Fred Katz:Brooks on Gary Payton II making the team:

“His toughness and his defensive ability to guard, we need that. We can score the ball. It seems our offense moves.”

Scott Brooks on Gary Payton II, Jan 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.
